about: Benton Accident & Injury Lawyers says it was founded in 2012 and is led by Jeff Benton, with verified offices in Dallas, Fort Worth, Brownsville and Seattle.

It publishes a fee statement rather than only a promise, along with a free case review, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach, which is what G5 asks for.

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 4 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed. The franchise tax does not reach a sole proprietorship or a general partnership, so this register can confirm an entity and cannot rule one out.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 1 named attorney published.

json_ld_descriptions: Benton Accident & Injury Lawyers is a Dallas-based personal injury law firm founded in 2012 and dedicated to fighting for victims of serious accidents and negligence throughout Texas. Led by attorney Jeff Benton, the firm handles a wide range of cases including car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, dog bites, pedestrian accidents, premises liability, workplace accidents, mass torts, and wrongful death. The firm serves clients across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and the greater Texas region, offering free consultations and working exclusively on a contingency fee basis — meaning clients pay nothing unless the firm wins. With a reputation built on results, personalized attention, and aggressive advocacy, Benton Accident & Injury Lawyers is available 24/7 to help injured Texans understand their rights and pursue the compensation they deserve.

Benton Accident & Injury Lawyers is a Texas personal injury law firm founded in 2012 and headquartered in Dallas. The firm is led by attorney Jeff Benton and focuses exclusively on representing individuals who have been injured due to the negligence of others. Practice areas include car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, dog bites, pedestrian accidents, premises liability, workplace accidents, mass torts, and wrongful death. The firm serves clients throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and across Texas, with additional offices in Fort Worth, Brownsville, and Seattle. Benton Accident & Injury Lawyers offers free consultations and operates on a contingency fee basis, so clients never pay out of pocket. The team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services in both English and Spanish to ensure every client receives the dedicated representation they deserve.
